changelog: - **A node can carry an icon before its name.** Select a Pool, Source, Drain, Gate, Converter or End and choose Icon in the Inspector: a cloud, wind, sun, remote control, tree, electricity, water, wave, airplane, car, nuclear plant, warehouse, medicine or game currency mark appears in front of the node's name, so a large model reads at a glance. The mark is a drawing only: it changes nothing a run computes, choosing or removing one never restarts the run, and it undoes like any edit. It shows at the normal and large zoom and folds away, with its gap, once the canvas is zoomed out to the compact levels; the model list in the left panel shows it in place of the kind mark, and a screen reader hears its name after the kind and the label. The icon is saved in the file and in share links (revision note `loop-revision/12`), and a file from an older version opens unchanged. The icon names and the field are in all 18 languages.
